description: Check local spec-planning setup after a trusted Codex session starts or resumes. No installation, network access, or scheduling occurs inside the hook.

hooks.command: planning_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && /bin/sh "$planning_root/meta/spec-planning/hooks/session-start.sh" || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Local spec-planning setup is incomplete: Git or the repository root is unavailable. Continue unrelated work; restore the prerequisite and start or resume Codex to retry."}}'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; try { $planningRoot = & git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Repository root unavailable' }; & (Join-Path $planningRoot 'meta/spec-planning/hooks/session-start.ps1') } catch { Write-Output 'Local spec-planning setup is incomplete: Git, PowerShell script execution, or the repository root is unavailable. Continue unrelated work; restore the prerequisite and start or resume Codex to retry.' }; exit 0"
